metadata.description: blueboard: Sentinel analytics rule (policy-reject-protected). Generated from docs/SECURITY.md detections.
Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled

properties.displayName: blueboard: action rejected for a protected user, device or indicator
properties.description: Someone (or an agent following injected instructions) asked the board to act on a protected asset. The policy refused it; find out why it was asked.
properties.query:
BlueboardAudit_CL
| where Event == "action.requested"
| extend Outcome = tostring(Detail.outcome), Notes = tostring(Detail.notes), Kind = tostring(Detail.kind)
| where Outcome == "Reject" and Notes has_any ("protected user", "protected device", "protected indicator")
| project TimeGenerated, Actor, ActorKind, Kind, Subject, Notes
